name: Baichuan AI
description: Baichuan's model platform with a 5M-token signup grant.
overview: Baichuan's platform serves the Baichuan 4 family behind an OpenAI-style API, with 5,000,000 free tokens for new accounts at 5 requests per minute. The weights of the open Baichuan 2 models are separately downloadable under Apache 2.0 for anyone who would rather self-host, but the hosted API is the free-to-call route that fits this catalogue.
free_access: Recharge only after the grant is spent
notes: Mainland platform: real-name verification and a Chinese payment method for top-ups.
